newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA 34 FOR ONE AT LUNCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA 34 FOR ONE AT LUNCH.

text.p: South Africa were 34 for one at lunch, in reply to India's first innings score of 237, on the second day of the third and final cricket test on Monday.
Gary Kirsten was batting on 18 and Herschelle Gibbs was yet to open his account. Andrew Hudson was the man out for 15.
Scores: India 237 (S.Tendulkar 61, W.Raman 57, N.Mongia 41, S.Ganguly 39, P.Adams 6-55, H.Cronje 2-11, B.McMillan 2-40). South Africa 34-1.
